fields.why: The claims (7 ill, 4 hospitalized, 2 in ICU, symptom frequencies) rest on counts and proportions; age is a population descriptor, not an outcome, so A's first continuous quote is off point. The median injection-to-onset interval (3 days) is a continuous summary of the illness, so A's 'continuous' is defensible but secondary.

brief_issues: Brief does not say whether a median incubation/interval in a small case series is a continuous outcome or descriptive context; a rule that descriptive medians of the population (age) never count, but medians of the illness's own course may, would settle it.
